title: Family membership horizon
description: An ordinary recorded citizen marking a membership state of one source family declaration version within one scope (ADR-0017 decision 1). Succession is explicit: predecessor is null only for the genesis horizon established before any member exists. Closure facts are keyed on the horizon current at attestation; horizon succession is an individuation root that displaces them (ADR-0017 decisions 2 and 5). The scope is a non-empty map of declared key names to values — a horizon is never global.
